cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you put my name under 'cake design' before you frame our club's prize certificate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Next year's members won't. There's a blank ready for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List us all, with what each did. I'll fetch everyone's names before you seal the frame.

mechanism: A uses its former lettering pupil improved skill and missing names to secure lasting credit on a shared cake certificate while accepting equal detailed credit for others.
confusable: Not monopolizing applause: A agrees to full team attribution provided its own specific contribution remains recorded.
comparison: Formal minutes preserving personal thanks versus permanent certificate dividing team roles.
